contexts.text: Only through chinks... does some light from Heaven enter, whereby they can think and reason. AC 3167:2. AC 3679:4. AC 4618:2. AC 5127:end. AC 6299:end. AC 6564. HH 430.
Instead of the magnificent temple there was seen a house full of chinks from top to bottom.
There was seen a house built of reeds, and consequently full of chinks.

When the spiritual mind is closed, the light of Heaven can only flow into the natural mind through chinks; and the light of Heaven flowing in through chinks into the Natural, is light separated from the heat of Heaven...
Hence it is evident what is signified by fissures, chinks of the rocks. Illustrated.
